Energy and Petroleum Regulatory Authority
Maximum retail pump prices, 15 September to 14 October 2026

The Authority has reviewed the maximum retail prices of petroleum products for the cycle starting
15 September 2026. In Nairobi, super petrol retails at a maximum of KSh 198.00 per litre.
Value Added Tax on fuel is charged at 16 per cent under the Value Added Tax Act.
The prices above include all taxes and levies.
